page0.text:
"...All right."
I'll look inside.
I have to find out where the missing bread went, and I have to go find her if Tohsaka isn't there.

page1.text:
I go inside, nervous for some reason.
"Uh, excuse me...?"
I ask in a whisper, but there's no response whatsoever.

page2.text:
"...Oh. So she's not here, like I thought."
The guestroom was the same as always.
There was nothing different than usual.
The only thing was this mysterious rectangular object on the table.

page3.text:
"...What is this?"
The length and width are about fifteen centimeters and the height is about sixteen centimeters. It's made out of plastic and looks like a lunchbox.

page4.text:
"Actually, it is a lunch box."
There're three of them stacked.
I have no idea what it's used for or why it's there.

page5.text:
"Why does Tohsaka..."
I get curious and reach out.
Then...
"Huh?"
I hear a sound of something rolling over behind me.

page6.text:
"Mm..."
A small sigh.
The sunlight must be bright, since she twists her body as if she's unable to sleep well and faces this way.

page8.text:
My thoughts are bleached white in an instant.
All white.
My breath stops instantly, and I can't look away.

page9.text:
"Uh... Uh..."
I gulp.
I don't even think that it's bad if I make a sound.
If we're talking loud, the pounding of my heart is louder.

page10.text:
"Ungh..."
No, calm down.
Be calm, be calm.
I can't afford to mess up right now.
I have to leave this room as if nothing happened, to ensure our cooperation runs smoothly in the future.
I'll probably be killed if Tohsaka wakes up now, so um... If I look at Tohsaka any longer, I won't be able to keep on cooperating with her.

page11.text: "Mm... Sorry... It'll take a bit longer..."

page12.text:
"Guh...!"
My body jumps back.
...Tohsaka is still sleeping.
She must be a deep sleeper, since she seems like she would still be sleeping if I let her be.

page13.text:
"...Phew."
I sigh with relief and slowly retreat.
...Meanwhile...
I know I shouldn't be looking, but I can't take my eyes off Tohsaka.

page14.text:
...There, was just a girl sleeping.
Tohsaka is a girl, and it makes me forget that she's a mage or a Master.

page15.text:
Her breath is as if she's unable to sleep well and her pajamas are disheveled.
If I see her like this, I won't be able to talk to her naturally like I have been up to now...

page17.text:
"...Hnng."
Her defenseless sleeping face.
I slowly retreat to the door, unable to look away.
...How long did that take?
The mere two meters of distance felt infinitely long, and I slide out to the hallway, suppressing my heart that's about to burst.

page18.text:
"Haah... Haah."
I take a deep breath.
I release the breath that I've been holding this whole time.

page19.text:
My knees give way, and I fall to the floor.
"...Geez, what the hell?"
...Well, I'm completely at fault.
It's my fault, but shouldn't extenuating circumstances be taken into consideration?

page20.text:
"...Sorry, Tohsaka."
The moment I murmur from the bottom of my heart, I suddenly feel tired.
"...Man."
Well, anyway...
I'm glad I was able to get out before I suffocated...

page21.text:
...Anyway, I decide to go make breakfast.
It'll be killing two birds with one stone because I can calm down if I make a well-prepared meal, and Tohsaka would be happy if it tastes good.

page22.text: "Good morning, Shirou. You are at ease this morning."

page23.text:
"Mm? Oh, morning, Saber. I can relax since it's Sunday and there's no school today. My body feels good too, so let's go to the dojo after breakfast."
I greet her while I peel the potatoes.

page24.text:
"Yes, that would be great. So your numbness has healed?"
"Oh, come to think of it, yeah. It healed while I was sleeping. It's still slightly heavy, but it should be fully healed by tomorrow."

page25.text:
"That is good. I have no place if my Master is still wounded. It makes me relieved to see you standing in the kitchen as usual."
Saber takes a seat at her usual position beside the table.

page26.text:
It's 8:30 AM.
I have to say that Fuji-nee and Tohsaka are sleepyheads for not waking up yet, but I can't complain today.

page27.text:
"...Yeah. Thanks to that, I'm starting to forget about it."
Tohsaka's sleeping face in my mind was fading away, due to the potatoes and onions.

page28.text:
I would be okay if Tohsaka were to come anytime now.
There's no doubt I would deal with it calmly like usual, as if nothing happened...
"Good morning, Rin. It seems you were able to sleep well last night."
"Guh...!!!!!!!!!"
My spine freezes.
I-I'm too scared that I can't look back at the living room.

page29.text:
"...Morning. Not really. The sunlight was bright, and there were some people moving about even past midnight."
...Tohsaka replies to Saber and enters the living room.

page30.text:
...
This is a crucial moment.
Calm down, calm down.
It's easy, I just have to brew tea for the three of us and greet her as I face her.

page31.text:
"...All right."
I put the teacups on the tray and take one final breath.

page32.text:
From the kitchen to the living room.
I put the tray on the table where they're gathered together.
"H-Hey. We're having potatoes and onions this morning, Tohsaka."

page33.text:
My breath stops.
Tohsaka is wearing something unfamiliar again.

page34.text:
"Ungh..."
I said to calm down.
It's okay, I saw her in normal clothes yesterday too. I should have some resistance now.

page35.text:
"No. I mean we're having Japanese cuisine this morning.
It'll take a bit longer, so have some tea for now."
I put teacups in front of Tohsaka and Saber.
Then...

page36.text:
"Why are you taking your time? We're going out today, so hurry up and get ready."
Tohsaka glares at me, as if to say that breakfast can come later.

page37.text:
"Huh...? Um, where are we going?"
"To the neighboring town. Actually, I want to go further, but we don't have the leisure, right? So it's a compromise."

page38.text:
"...?"
Is this some sort of pre-emptive strike?
I can't seem to grasp Tohsaka's intentions.

page39.text:
"Okay. I get that it's a compromise, but for what?"
"We're going to go have fun, of course. It's a date."

page40.text:
"A date... Who and who?"
"You and I."
She says clearly.
"...?"
After I tilt my head in wonder...

page41.text:
"D-DATE... ME AND TOHSAKAAAAAAA!?"
"Who else is there? I told you last night."
"Guh..."

page42.text:
I feel dizzy.
I want to say something back, but Tohsaka is standing so majestically, I can't even object.

page43.text:
"Come on, let's go. I figured this would happen, so I made lunch. Here, hold this and follow me."
Tohsaka pushes the green tote bag onto me and leaves the living room.
